 From start to finish, our direct mail service does it all.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Free Premade Designs
 
 
 Customize a variety of royalty-free designs with our card sending service. Select from hundreds of creative mailer design templates for any occasion or create your own.
 
 
 
 
 
 Postal Protect
℠
 Coating
 
 
 Mail with confidence knowing our direct mailer printing service's Postal Protect
℠
 process will ensure your products are delivered in the best condition possible.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Printing, Addressing & Mailing
 
 
 With Amazingmail, you can send marketing mailers and cards online by mail! Our direct mail marketing service will print, address, stamp, and mail your cards with durable Postal Protect℠ coating and postage included.
 
 
 
 
 
 Next Business Day
 
 
 Have a last minute order? Our same day mail service will print and mail the next business day, whether you’re sending postcards online individually or by the thousands.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What customers are saying:
 
 
 
 
 
 "With Amazingmail, you can go from concept, to design, to mailing...in under a day!"

Free Samples

 
Quality mail products that sell themselves

 

 Our direct mail printing service's cards make you look good! At Amazing Mail, we pride ourselves in the premium materials we 
 use, allowing us to produce card quality that is second to none. Experience our product quality first hand by requesting 
 some samples. Our direct mail printing service team can send you a sample kit that showcases a variety of different sizes 
 or provide you with a free card credit in your account, allowing you to create and mail your own personalized sample online. 
 Let us know what you prefer.

Lock in savings by pre-purchasing Postcard Credits

 
Amazingmail allows you to pre-purchase postcard credits to receive volume discounts and avoid postage increases for the next 2 years.

 
It's simple: when you purchase blank postcard credits at today’s postage rate, you can use them anytime in the next two years without incurring additional costs. Send one card at a time or thousands, changing the graphics and recipients as often as you'd like.
